text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Health minister announces revamp of hospital organisational structure to cut waiting lists.

- Former police commissioner Lawrence Pullicino loses claim of breach of fair trial. Pullicino is serving a 15-year jail term after trial in which he was convicted of complicity in inflicting grievous injuries on a man during questioning at police headquarters. The man later died. Pullicino claimed the judge and jury were influenced by a bad press and he was discriminated against politically.

- General Workers' Union discusses dockyard report prepared by British consultants and suggesting the yard be split and one part concentrate on ship repair and one on other business initiatives. The GWU said it would discuss the report with the government. It felt all resources should be concentrated on ship repair, although it was not against the dockyard being involved in other business.
